name: SketchCraft — free open-source SketchUp-style 3D modeler
summary: Desktop push/pull modeler for houses, rooms, furniture and props: draw an outline, pull it up, type exact sizes. Opens SketchUp (.skp), DXF/DWG, IFC, FBX/OBJ and point-cloud scans; saves glTF, FBX, OBJ, STL, DAE, IFC, PDF, MP4. Groups, components, tags, renders, section cuts, a Cut list plugin, plus a CLI and MCP server for agents. Mac, Windows, Linux; self-updating.

access.notes: Builds are not code-signed yet (macOS: Open Anyway; Windows: Run anyway). DWG and IFC import need a free helper. Clean-room project, not affiliated with SketchUp/Trimble.

procedure: Download the file for your computer: universal .dmg (Mac), x64-setup.exe / .msi / portable zip (Windows), AppImage / .deb / .rpm (Linux)
First launch: allow the unsigned app (Mac: System Settings > Privacy & Security > Open Anyway; Windows: More info > Run anyway)
Click Learn (top right) for the built-in lessons

verdict.why: Free MIT SketchUp-like modeler that actually opens .skp and exports glTF/FBX for games; downloadable builds for all three OSes. Young project (repo created Nov 13), unsigned binaries.
